title: Bloobs Adventure Idle
description:
Bloobs Adventure Idle is a massive RuneScape-inspired idle RPG built around endless progression, powerful account growth, and thousands of goals to pursue.

Train 24 interconnected skills, defeat powerful bosses, collect over 500 souls, complete thousands of challenges, and scale your character through a deep prestige system designed for hundreds — and eventually thousands — of hours of progression.

Whether actively managing your build or progressing while offline, every action pushes your account further toward true endgame power.

Skilling and CraftingTrain 24 unique skills — including Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing, Cooking, Magic, Thieving, BeastMastery, and more.

Skills feed into one another through layered progression systems where every upgrade strengthens your entire account. Gather resources, craft stronger equipment, unlock new systems, and push deeper into increasingly rewarding content.

Prestige skills to gain permanent bonuses, accelerate future progression, and continue scaling far beyond the early game.

Combat and EquipmentCombat is automated — but power is earned.

Build your character, craft stronger gear, optimize your progression, and challenge increasingly dangerous bosses designed to test your stats, equipment, and preparation.

Rare drops, unique equipment, soul collection, and permanent progression systems create an endless climb toward greater power.

The stronger your account becomes, the faster the world opens around you.

Challenges, Collections, and DiscoveryBloobs Adventure Idle is built for players who love long-term progression and meaningful discovery.

Complete thousands of challenges across combat, skilling, exploration, progression, and collection systems to unlock milestone rewards, permanent upgrades, and hidden memories scattered throughout the world.

Track your journey through the Beastiary, Item Compendium, Thief’s Log, Achievements, and Souldex — featuring over 500 collectible souls with unique variations and bonuses.

Recover lost memories to expand the Lore Book and uncover fragments of the world hidden behind your progression.

There is always another goal to chase, another reward to unlock, and another mystery waiting to be discovered.

Banked Time SystemProgress on your schedule.

Store up to 36 hours of offline time and spend it whenever you choose to accelerate skills, combat, crafting, and progression. Dexterity Prestige increases the cap by 6 hours per level, up to a maximum of 96 hours.

You don’t just idle.

You control when progression accelerates.

Bloobs Adventure Idle combines familiar RuneScape-inspired skilling with layered systems designed for long-term progression. Prestige, skill synergy, and exploration come together in a steady loop that continues to grow with you.
description_short: A massive RuneScape-inspired idle RPG built for long-term progression. Train 24 skills, defeat bosses, collect over 500 souls, and bank offline time to accelerate your progress whenever you choose.
